tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Compile the Robot Controller app (robot + framework + pedro + FtcRobotController)

tasks.label: Test framework
tasks.detail: Run the behavior tree unit tests (no robot needed)

tasks.label: Deploy to robot
tasks.detail: Install the app on the connected Control Hub / phone and start it

tasks.label: Connect to Control Hub (Wi-Fi)
tasks.detail: Connect adb to a Control Hub whose Wi-Fi network this computer has joined

tasks.label: Run behavior tree visualizer
tasks.detail: Run examples/general/BehaviorBasics and show its tree live at http://localhost:8765

tasks.label: Refresh VS Code classpath
tasks.detail: Export library jars so VS Code can resolve FTC SDK and Pedro Pathing classes
